title: Amazing app
body: It feels very well made I love the UI. Everything just works and looks good while doing it.
author: OscarrrP

title: Feature request
body: Loving this app so far. One feature I would like to see is being able to set a habit to a certain amount of days a week eg. Workouts 3 days per week
author: todd_10

title: Need feature
body: I need to purchase this app. Really good UI design and matching with ios. But one thing I needed is missing. I need sub tasks with time for each. As example main task is music. Sub task is breathing, vocal warm up. Each sub task must have a timer to log the practice time.
author: leolk123456
